name: reports_search
description: Find which report covers a topic, such as orders, refunds or revenue, in the report catalog of the signed-in tenant. Returns report names, titles and current version. Read-only. Use it to find a report name before exporting.

name: exports_create
description: Create one export file of one report for one calendar day and deliver it to a destination. Changes external state: every successful call creates a new export and a delivery; to re-run a failed export, call it again, which creates a new export. Formats csv or parquet; finance_sftp accepts csv only. Pass the report version the user saw as expected_report_version. The tenant comes from the signed-in session.

report.description: Report name from reports_search, e.g. daily_orders.

day.description: Calendar day of the report in the report's own timezone, YYYY-MM-DD.

expected_report_version.description: The report version the user saw. The call fails if the report has changed since.

name: exports_get_status
description: Check whether one known export has finished: returns its status (queued, running, delivered or failed) with report, day, format and destination. Needs the export_id; use exports_list when you do not have it. Read-only. response_format concise (default) or detailed.

name: exports_list
description: List recent exports of the signed-in tenant, newest first, optionally only those with one status or since a day. Use it to find an export_id. Read-only. Returns at most limit items and a next_cursor when more exist.

since.description: Calendar day of the report in the report's own timezone, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: exports_read_log
description: Read lines from the job log of one export. Read-only. Defaults to the last 40 lines, where failures are reported. The result gives total_lines, the range returned and a cursor for the lines omitted.

name: exports_cancel
description: Cancel a queued or running export by export_id. Changes external state. A delivered export cannot be cancelled.
